name: Convolution reverb, a 2 s hall, wet only
notes: Fancy Verb against MConvolutionEZ (MeldaProduction, free). A convolution reverb's settings are mostly its impulse response, which isn't a host parameter, so each plugin loads a preset saved from REAPER: a hall of about 2 s, 100 % wet, no dry. In REAPER: load the plugin, choose the IR (Fancy Verb: File module, Library > Halls > Concert Hall), set Wet 0 dB and Dry off, then the FX window's + menu > Export VST preset, into examples/presets/ under the names below. Distortion and aliasing aren't measured: convolution is linear.
